description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git pack corruption resilience. It contains test setup functions, test cases that intentionally corrupt pack files, and validation logic to ensure Git can recover from various corruption scenarios. The script also includes delta application tests and edge case validations related to Git's pack object processing.

methods.name: create_test_files
methods.description: Creates sample files with random content and specific labels to set up test objects.

methods.name: create_new_pack
methods.description: Initializes a new Git repository, creates blobs from test files, and packs them into a pack file, then verifies the pack.

methods.name: do_repack
methods.description: Recreates the pack files, potentially introducing corruption for testing recovery.

methods.name: do_corrupt_object
methods.description: Corrupts a specific object in the pack file at a given offset.
